name: pit-deep-spiral shift (minqueue)
source: Generated with minehaulsim 0.11.0 (pypi.org/project/minehaulsim, Apache-2.0): deterministic DES on a constrained road network (rimpull speed-by-grade, direction zones, emergent bunching), seeded parametric mine generator.

generator.scenario: 16 benches x 10.0 m, spiral ramp (1 lane), 6 shovels, 2 dumps, 42 trucks

caveats: Synthetic cycle log (structure-real): the road network, grades, speeds and queueing are simulated physics; the mine itself is generated, not a real operation. Equipment curves are class-representative, not OEM data. No calibration to any specific mine is claimed.

geology.note: SYNTHETIC bench-aligned deposit (oreblocks): per-bench statistics of the EXACT ultimate pit. Vertical axis matches the pit benches; the horizontal footprint is generic, not the haulage superellipse.
